violated_contract: A denied durable-completion proof must not turn a legacy sync status handle into an indefinitely retryable HTTP 503. Privacy denials must preserve the legacy status and local audio custody; only failed reads remain retryable.
canonical_prevention: Separate typed privacy denials from fence-read errors at the reconciliation boundary, retain the pre-reconciliation status path, and verify every real fence reason against flag-off responses and the actual client WAL policy using shared test vectors.
